title: Arts Court

services.name: Venue Rentals
services.desc: With 4 theatres, 7+ studios, conference rooms and more, Arts Court provides hundreds of clients with venue space for arts events, workshops, conferences, and performances each year. Organizations including the Ottawa Fringe Festival, Arts Ottawa, Ottawa Dance Directive (ODD), SAW Gallery, and Digital Arts Resource Centre (DARC) manage these spaces while also providing programming year round. Arts Court Theatre is a multi-occasion performance venue. This black box theatre space is fully outfitted with professional sound and lighting capabilities suitable for theatre and concert performances as well as dance, workshop, conferences, screening presentations.
